methods.label: Multiply the dimension factors
methods.explanation:
A rectangular box's volume is its length times its width times its height. Multiplying the height by \(2\), the width by \(3\), and keeping the length unchanged therefore multiplies the volume by
\[
2\cdot3\cdot1=6.
\]
For the same clay packed in the same way, six times the volume holds six times the mass. Thus
\[
n=6\cdot40=240
\]
grams, choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
methods.levelReason: The rectangular-prism volume formula and elementary proportional scaling suffice.
